title: Job 7798450 FAILED on r2n5 — power collapse at failure time
summary: Job 7798450 (qmc_solver) on r2n5 entered FAILED state at ~15:30 UTC (exit_code 1:0, reason JobLaunchFailure). IPMI total_power on r2n5 dropped from ~730W to ~260W and CPU package power (p0_power/p1_power) fell to idle at the same time, consistent with the workload terminating.

timeline.event: Snapshot captured — r2n5 at idle power

notes: Check the job's stderr for the launch failure; node hardware looks healthy (idle power normal).
